name: Monaco Telecom DC3
notes: DC3 protected zone created by Arrete Ministeriel 2019-452 (Journal 8435, 24/05/2019): computer room on 4th floor of Zone F building, 6 avenue Albert II. 2025 ISO/HDS certificate lists 4-6 avenue Albert II - Zone F (primary/head office and DC3). Historical 2014/2015 press: ~1,000 m2 / ~200 racks, EUR 6m investment (Grade B context only). 12 kW/rack, 2N power platform claims; no MW published, capacity_mw null per MC methodology.

name: Monaco Telecom Centre de donnees n.6
notes: 2025 ISO/HDS certificate lists 'Zone F, 4-6 avenue Albert II' as Centre de donnees n.6; part of the 3 certified Monaco Telecom data centers in the Principality. Same Zone F cluster as DC3; capacity_mw null per methodology (no MW published).

name: Telis / MonacoDATACENTER
notes: First green datacenter in Monaco, operational since 2013 at Le George V, 14 avenue de Grande-Bretagne, 98000 Monaco. ISO 27001/HDS certified, Tier III-designed, seawater free-cooling, 99.997% claimed availability, 24/7/365 supervision. No MW published; energy-saving claims not converted to MW per methodology.

name: Monaco Telecom Zone J (legacy main data centre, under Centre Commercial de Fontvieille)
notes: One of Monaco Telecom's main data centres, located under the Fontvieille shopping centre ('Zone J'); 29 Nov 2022 outage caused by SMEG grid maintenance disconnection and generator failure (Grade B resilience/location evidence). Nice-Matin (12 Oct 2024) reports Monaco Telecom relocation from the Fontvieille shopping centre was blocked because the centre was never restructured, leading to the Grand Ida data center instead. Relationship to the three current certified centres pending MT/SMEG/Journal confirmation.

name: Monaco Cloud (sovereign cloud platform)
notes: Operator of Monaco's state sovereign cloud (Extended Monaco program), operational since Oct 2021; multi-site platform, data stored in Monaco under Monegasque law, AMSN-qualified (PINH Avance/PSSI-E), HDS certified. HQ at 9 avenue Albert II - Le Copori (Fontvieille). Counted as platform, not standalone physical facility; physical footprint maps through Monaco Telecom/Telis hosting sites. capacity_mw null.

name: DRSI government computer room (23 avenue Albert II)
developer: Monaco State - DSI/DRSI (Direction des Reseaux et Systemes d'Information)
notes: Protected zone created by Arrete Ministeriel 2019-453 (Journal 8435, 24/05/2019) for the DRSI computer room, 1st floor, 23 avenue Albert II (confirmed via gouv.mc administrative directory). Public-sector server room, not commercial colocation.

name: Monaco Telecom Centre de donnees n.1 (25 boulevard de Suisse)
notes: 2025 ISO/HDS certificate lists 25 boulevard de Suisse, 98000 Monaco as Centre de donnees n.1. Boulevard de Suisse is at the Monte-Carlo/Sainte-Devote boundary; assigned to Monte-Carlo per methodology default, verify against repo quarter geometry.

name: Monaco Telecom Larvotto Superieur data center
developer: Monaco Telecom (project by Monaco State / Direction des Travaux Publics)
notes: Journal 8649 tender (30/06/2023): Monaco Telecom data center of about 1,600 m2 on levels R-3/R-4 of Larvotto Superieur residential tower at 19 boulevard du Larvotto, max 36-month works period; communal council validated project early 2024; National Council approved parcel decommissioning 2 Apr 2026; delivery target 2028 (Nice-Matin). DCD reports 1,550 m2 / EUR 45m; dcmag.fr (2026) reports 1,318 m2 on ~1,080 m2 plot. Keep status approved/under development until commissioning source; official wording 1,600 m2 preferred. Larvotto/Saint-Roman boundary check required.

name: Monaco Telecom Grand Ida data center (quartier Plati)
notes: Monaco Telecom data center planned in bloc A of the Grand Ida residential complex, quartier Plati (rue Plati / boulevard Rainier III), ~4 levels of the building, backup generators at R+4, thalasso-thermal cooling loop; destination change via modified building permit of 21 June 2024; legal challenge by 24 of 40 dationnaire owners (recours gracieux rejected 2025, possible Tribunal supreme). Presented as relocation of the data centre blocked at the Fontvieille shopping centre (Zone J). Assigned to Jardin Exotique (Plati area; boundary with Moneghetti to be confirmed by repo geometry). Grade B (named-party trade/local press + referenced official permit).
